descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S26 Add form submitted: an untouched Hospital form saves Follow-up; Consult chosen on the Nursing Home form saves Consult

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 The manual add form has the three-state toggle (New Admission / Follow-up / Consult) at creation, it defaults to Follow-up, and the state chosen there (or left untouched) is the one saved (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 2; TFA-92584 AC 3)
  • U1 Nothing is ever New Admission (or Consult) unless the physician set it: the app never guesses the status, and a patient nobody has set reads Follow-up (UAT TC-06)
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3) (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.3; TFA-92584 AC 7)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Session fixture; Hospital Add Patient form and Nursing Home Add Resident form

When Hospital: fill Full Name 'QA Add Hosp', Age 70, Room 5C-01, Diagnosis 'Cellulitis of the left leg', leave Encounter Type untouched, press Add Patient to Rounds, open the new patient's chart. Nursing Home: fill Full Name 'QA Add Resident', choose Consult in Encounter Type, press Add to Resident Panel, open the new resi …

Then QA Add Hosp reads Follow-up on the list and in the chart with SOAP progress pre-selected (stored encType 'follow-up' or unset); QA Add Resident reads Consult in the chart (stored encType 'consult' with today's day)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-06 step 2 + 'Scanned and manually added patients both default to Follow-up' + TFA-92584 AC 2, 3. This is the cell PR #74 changed (the Hospital add form used to default to New Admission; Quinn's default (e)), and no lane A spec submits an untouched Hospital form (S04 chooses Consult). oracle.mjs on [selected] options and list text with anchors; …

Where it ran: dev unit U74; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-06/S26

Add form submitted: an untouched Hospital form saves Follow-up; Consult chosen on the Nursing Home form saves Consult

Tickets: TFA-92584 Admission Status Toggle (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U74.verdict.json), unit U74. Agent: 38 turns, 99 s, $0.25.

Recorded (evidence only):

  • (backend): (positive control: the Add Patient form saved one row (two mean it was submitted twice)) pass: backend h-list-after [name={addHosp}] has 1 item
  • (backend): (positive control: the Add Resident form saved one row) pass: backend n-list-after [name={addResident}] has 1 item

Plan said: not-runnable-on-dev: permission-add-patient — this run has a result anyway, so the result is shown.

Plan: unit U74 (#74, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Add form submitted: an untouched Hospital form saves Follow-up; Consult chosen o. add-patient / upload runner (2026-10-14); its own seed and added rows only
